name: Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A.
summary: Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. provides electricity distribution services in the state of Maranhão, Brazil. It serves residential, industrial, and commercial customers. The company was formerly known as Companhia Energética do Maranhão  CEMAR and changed it to Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. in September 2019. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in São Luís, Brazil. Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. is a subsidiary of Equatorial Energia Distribuição S.A.
